title: Anthropic launches new Claude Fable and Mythos 5.2 models
raw_excerpt: Anthropic is announcing two new models today: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, which it says are designed to take on "daunting" technical challenges. The company claims the new models show improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision, and can generate outputs faster than the 5.1 versions of the Fable and Mythos models. Claude Fable 5.2 is good at challenging software engineering problems, Anthropic says, and can orchestrate agent teams and tackle long-running projects. The new model has also solved some complex scientific problems, including two open theoretical physics problems. summary: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.2 与 Claude Mythos 5.2 两款模型，前者面向普通用户并内置安全防护，后者面向通过审核的网络安全与生命科学机构。官方称新模型在编码、推理与视觉能力上均有提升，生成速度最高提升 30%，API 调用费用下调 20%。Fable 5.2 在预发布测试中解决了两个开放理论物理问题，并在 Artificial Analysis 上获得 65 分，为目前最高分。

title: OpenAI Reportedly Raises $11 Billion at $1.25 Trillion Valuation
raw_excerpt: OpenAI reportedly secured $11 billion in a new funding round at a $1.25 trillion valuation, with the round potentially reaching $20 billion before closing. The amount fell short of its previously reported $30 billion fundraising target, amid growing investor uncertainty around AI valuations.
summary: 据 TechCrunch 报道，OpenAI 在新一轮融资中筹集 110 亿美元，估值达 1.25 万亿美元，最终规模可能扩大至 200 亿美元。这一数字低于此前报道的 300 亿美元融资目标，反映出投资者对 AI 估值的担忧正在升温。该消息是观察当前 AI 资本市场情绪的重要信号。

title: TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max
summary: 谷歌发布新一代 TPU 芯片 TPU 8tx 与 TPU 8i Max，并介绍了其在全球网络与云基础设施中的部署方式。作为谷歌自研 AI 加速器的重大更新，新芯片将直接影响其云上 AI 训练与推理的成本和性能，也是对英伟达 GPU 主导地位的一次正面回应。

title: Google Gemini routes personal Drive files and emails to human annotators
summary: GitHub 上出现一份调查报告，称 Google Gemini 会将用户的个人 Drive 文件与邮件内容路由给人工标注员查看。该帖在 Hacker News 获得 584 分、128 条评论，引发对 AI 助手隐私边界的广泛讨论。对于企业用户和个人用户而言，这涉及云 AI 服务数据处理透明度的核心问题。

title: How Anthropic Builds Agent Memory
raw_excerpt: Anthropic explored how AI agents can build effective long-term memory by capturing experiences during interactions and reorganizing them during idle periods through a process called “dreaming.” The post examines how different memory components contribute to organizing and retaining useful information.
summary: Anthropic 发布关于 Agent 长期记忆构建的研究，探讨 AI 智能体如何在交互中捕获经验，并在空闲时段通过名为“dreaming”的过程重新组织记忆。文章分析了不同记忆组件在组织与保留有用信息方面的作用，为构建可长期运行的 Agent 系统提供了方法论参考。

title: A proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture
raw_excerpt: The Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, a key open problem in quantum complexity theory, has been proven by a research system developed at PSI using an Anthropic model. This proof shows quantum computers are not exponentially faster on random inputs compared to classical ones, resolving a significant question about quantum speedups.
summary: PSI 研究团队利用 Anthropic 模型构建的研究系统，证明了量子复杂度理论中的关键开放问题——Aaronson-Ambainis 猜想。该证明表明量子计算机在随机输入上并不比经典计算机指数级更快，解决了关于量子加速的重要问题。这是 AI 辅助数学研究的一次标志性成果。

title: How Well Does AI Peer Review Work? A Benchmark Built from 100 Planted Errors
raw_excerpt:
作者: Paul Litvak
摘要: One hundred known errors were planted into 10 open-access psychology papers, and the modified papers were then run through frontier models and two commercial AI review tools. The best single system caught 71 of the 100 errors, while the worst caught 30. Pooling every system's output caught 93. Models are only partly correlated in the errors they find, which makes ensembling a big lever for finding issues in papers. Seven errors could not be caught by any system, and all seven were omissions: information deleted from a paper rather than mistakes inserted into it. Refine.ink contributes more unique catches than any other single system, though it is expensive on a per-error basis. False positives were not measured, and how this error distribution compares to the distribution of errors in real papers remains unknown. The papers, errors, model outputs, and full experiment log are public, so that others can build on this toward a comprehensive evaluation benchmark across disciplines.
summary: 一项研究将 100 个已知错误植入 10 篇开放获取心理学论文，再用前沿模型和两款商业 AI 审稿工具检测。最佳单一系统发现 71 个错误，最差仅 30 个；汇总所有系统输出可发现 93 个。模型发现的错误仅部分相关，说明集成多种系统是提升 AI 审稿效果的关键杠杆。
